title: Partner onboarding — morning scratch
content:
Quick morning scratchpad for partner onboarding (marketplace). Mostly notes-to-self and action checklist. Will refine into partner-facing playbook after standup.

Top context:
- Partner: DataWeave.ai (early integration). Wants marketplace listing + hosted integration flow.
- Primary contact: Tom Hargreaves (tom@dataweave.ai) — kickoff yesterday.
- Goal for week: working demo + embed instructions for self-serve listing; API test tokens for staging; pricing tier mapping.

Morning goals (high priority):
- [ ] Generate staging API token for DataWeave (scoped: embeddings + generation). Need to set expiration 30d.
- [ ] Confirm redirect URI for OAuth flow: https://app.dataweave.ai/oauth/callback — ask security if we need additional validations.
- [ ] Create a minimal example repo (README + example requests) and push to GH: marketplace-examples/dataweave.
- [ ] Draft marketplace listing blurb (150–200 words) and get marketing eyes.

Integration checklist (quick, messy):
1) Auth
   - OAuth vs API-key decision: partner prefers OAuth for SSO; product prefers API-key for simplicity. Action: scope decision doc (small pros/cons).
   - TODO: Ask legal about token retention for marketplace partners.
2) API surface to show in demo
   - text generation endpoint: POST /v1/generate (include sample prompt + streaming note)
   - embeddings: POST /v1/embeddings
   - rate limits: start with 60rpm on staging, note cost implication.
3) Deployment and QA
   - provide staging model variant: redwood/gptx-16k-qa (quantized) — verify output parity with hosted model.
   - KV cache: enable prefix caching for canned prompts (reduce cost).
4) Billing/pricing
   - map partner usage to marketplace SKU: sku-marketplace-proto-A. Send pricing note to finance.

Notes from yesterday's call (shorthand):
- Tom: needs example that shows redirect + callback trace; wants minimal latency (50–80ms hopeful).
- Ethan: flagged privacy question around eval logs; need to disable logging by default for partner test. (see PART-342)
- Riley: will handle listing artwork/thumbnail.

Commands / snippets to include in example repo (put in README):
- curl example for generation:
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n    -d '{"model":"redwood/gptx-16k-qa","input":"Summarize the following..."}'

- minimal node snippet for embeddings (pseudocode)

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal signoff for partner data retention (who owns eval logs?)
- Do we enable canary network routing for partner in Dedicated? Extra ops work.
- Which SLA do we promise on marketplace listing page (need a standard blurb).

Followups (assign):
- Aisha: create example repo + staging token (due EOD)
- Ethan: check logging/privacy and PART-342 (due tomorrow)
summary: Personal scratchpad for marketplace partner onboarding; tasks, call notes, integration checklist, commands, and open questions. Draft status; will convert to partner-facing docs after internal review.
